spans.s:
तितिक्ष, अस्, m. (fr. Desid. of rt. तिज्), N. of a man;
(आ), f. endurance, patience, resignation, suffering,
forbearance; Patience personified as a daughter of
Dakṣa and wife of Dharma and mother of Kṣema.
तितिक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, borne, endured, suffered.

तितिक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, bearing, enduring patiently,
patient, resigned, forbearing; (उस्), m., N. of a son
of Mahā-manas and descendant of Janam-ejaya.

तितउ तित-उ, उस्, उ, m. n. (said to be fr. rt.
3. तन् by a kind of reduplication, cf. τιταίνω but
perhaps fr. rt. तंस्), a sieve, a cribble; a parasol; [cf.
चालनी.]

तितनिषु तितनिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of
rt. 3. तन्), desirous of extending or enlarging.
तितिभ तितिभ, अस्, m. an insect, cochineal.
तितिरि तितिरि, इस्, m. = तित्तिरि, a partridge.

तित्तिरि तित्तिरि, इस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. तॄ,
but perhaps an onomatopoetic word fr. the cry
तित्ति), the francoline partridge; N. of a Muni, pupil
of Yāska, and said to be the first teacher of the
Taittirīya or Black Yajur-veda; (according to a
legend the pupils of Vaiśampāyana became par-
tridges in order to pick up the Veda which was
vomited forth in a tangible shape by Yājñavalkya;
cf. तैत्तिरीय); N. of a Nāga; [cf. Gr. τέτριξ,
τέτραξ, τετράων, τετράζω; Old Island. thid-r, ‘a
kind of hen;’ Lith. tetèrva, ‘black grouse;’ Boh.
tetrev.]

तितिल तितिल, अम्, n. a sort of sweetmeat
made of sesamum ground and baked with sugar; one
of the seven Karaṇas or astronomical periods; a
bowl or bucket, = नन्दक.

तितीर्षा तितीर्षा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. तॄ),
desire of crossing over, wish to pass, wish to be freed
from mundane existence, desire of final emancipation.

तितीर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of crossing; wishing
to attain; desirous of emancipation from existence.

तित्तिड तित्तिड and तित्तिडीक, incorrect forms
for तिन्तिड and तिन्तिडीक.

तित्तिर तित्तिर, अस्, m. = तित्तिरि, col. 3; (आस्),
m. pl., N. of a race.
तित्तिरिक, अस्, m. the francoline partridge.

तित्तिरीक, अस्, आ, अम्, variegated like a partridge
(तित्तिरि) or made of Croton Tiglium (तित्तिरी-फल).
